```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
folder_path_demo <- "."

# Both are Numbers files; attempt CSV import when applicable
demo1 <- read.csv(file.path(folder_path_demo, "pilot_validate_data_demo.csv"))
demo2 <- read.csv(file.path(folder_path_demo, "pilot_demo_final.csv"))

head(demo1)
head(demo2)
colnames(demo1)
colnames(demo2)
```
```{r}
# Standardize column names
demo1 <- demo1 %>% rename(
  age       = Age,
  condition = Condition,
  english   = English_literacy,
  education = highest_education,
  gender    = Gender,
  nationality = Nationality
)

demo2 <- demo2 %>% rename(
  age       = age,
  condition = Condition,
  english   = english,
  education = education,
  gender    = Gender,
  nationality = Nationality
)

# Merge
demo_all <- bind_rows(demo1, demo2)

# Correct spelling errors and merge the two Categorization datasets
demo_all <- demo_all %>%
  mutate(condition = recode(condition, "Catergorization" = "Categorization"))

# Rebuild the summary table
demo_table <- demo_all %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  summarise(
    N        = n(),
    Age_mean = round(mean(age, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Age_sd   = round(sd(age,   na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Female   = sum(gender == "F", na.rm = TRUE),
    Male     = sum(gender == "M", na.rm = TRUE)
  )

print(demo_table)
```
